verification.note: Later paperback reprint: imprint visually checked. Complete English preface ix–x, General Introduction xi–xxiv and its notes 1–35 (205–207) read via OCR because embedded font text is corrupt. Chapter 1 notes 1–21 read, not chapter body. Preface and note 8 credit Giard, Mayol and Ferrier. Notes 3, 9 and 20 specify conceptual resources. Body chapters and French original not collated. Broad colonial, gender and biological formulations are not adopted as facts; erroneous Xun Zi identification in note 24 not copied.

verification.note: Primary introduction, selected definitional passages and conclusion on mediation read in the 1909 reprint. The authors acknowledge Tylor, Robertson Smith and Frazer while proposing a different, explicitly provisional theory; they distinguish participants and ritual movement between sacred and profane. UQAM catalogue confirms original L’Année sociologique 2 (1899), 29–138: https://classiques.uqam.ca/classiques/mauss_marcel/oeuvres_1/oeuvres_1_3/essai_sacrifice.html . Detailed Sanskrit/Hebrew cases not independently checked.
